text: Entries 1373 and 1374 add pref_true and pref_false arrays. With normal filtering enabled, checkProfile rejects when any required true preference is not true or any required false preference is true. This means each array is an all-members condition; an empty array has no restriction and a non-array value is ignored. Across separate include profiles the caller uses some, so the profile combination has a different boundary. This is a scoped targeting contract, not a general array-style policy. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source landing alone does not establish reviewer approval.
title: Preference targeting requires every listed value to match
